rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches Caddy's architecture, including Caddyfile directives, server options parsing, and module registration.
rationale.edge_cases: Excellent handling of 0-byte writes, io.ReaderFrom chunking limits, missing underlying deadlines (deadlineNA check), and HardDeadline ceilings.
rationale.scope: Implements all requested functionality exactly as specified, including the requested 1-minute server-level defaults and all Caddyfile options.
rationale.readability: Cleanly separated types for reader/writer, clear purpose-driven comments, and logically structured Caddyfile parsing.
rationale.robustness: Uses http.ResponseController correctly for modern HTTP compat, limits chunk sizes on io.ReaderFrom to ensure deadline checks, and avoids panics on unsupported connections.
rationale.maintainability: Modular design with standalone IdleTimeoutReader/Writer that can be reused; cleanly extends the existing server and middleware chain.
